{{Top|notoc=1}}
{{Quote|We're passing through the magnetic field! Hold tight! Switch your deflectors on, double-front!|[[Garven Dreis/Legends|Garven Dreis]]|<ref name="Episode 4">{{Film|IV}}</ref>}}
[[File:Planetary_Pioneers.jpg|thumb|right|250px|The [[Planetary Pioneers]] attempt to penetrate the [[Unidentified maverick moon|maverick moon's]] strong magnetic field]]
A '''magnetic field''', also called a '''magnetic forcefield''',<ref name="DSTC">''[[Death Star Technical Companion]]''</ref> '''magnetic shield''', '''magnetic containment field''', '''magcon field''', or '''atmosphere containment field''', was a type of [[Force field/Legends|force field]] that was generated in order to contain [[Atmosphere/Legends|atmosphere]] inside a space such as a [[Hangar/Legends|hangar]], and the [[Vacuum/Legends|vacuum]] of [[Realspace/Legends|space]] outside.<ref name="EGTD">''[[The Essential Guide to Droids]]''</ref>

[[Planet/Legends|Planets]] were capable of generating their own natural magnetic fields,<ref name="RPG">[[Star Wars: The Roleplaying Game (first edition)|''Star Wars: The Roleplaying Game'']]</ref> and some more unusual planetary magnetic fields could interfere with the operation of [[Repulsorlift/Legends|repulsorlift]] vehicles.<ref name="EGVV">''[[The Essential Guide to Vehicles and Vessels]]''</ref>

Magnetic fields were used throughout [[The galaxy/Legends|the galaxy]] to contain the atmosphere within [[Starship/Legends|starship]] [[Hangar/Legends|hangars]], as well as to protect [[Pilot/Legends|pilots]] who were forced to abandon their vehicles while in [[Realspace/Legends|realspace]] and did not have the benefit of environmental or vac-rated life-support [[Environment suit/Legends|enviro-suits]]. In addition, magcon fields were used on starships to help shield against the effects of [[Ion storm/Legends|ion storms]] and other forms of potentially damaging interstellar [[Radiation/Legends|radiation]]. Fields of this type kept in air, but were notoriously poor at retaining heat, resulting in cold temperatures.

[[Magnacuffs/Legends|Magnacuffs]] employed micromagnetic fields to lock their restraining bands into position.<ref name="EGWT">''[[The Essential Guide to Weapons and Technology]]''</ref>

Both [[Death Star/Legends|Death Stars]] had quite large magnetic fields.
